findings.motion: HB 958, Election Law Changes, House second reading (passed 66-47)
findings.note: Voted no on second reading. The ratified bill (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v9.pdf) requires a voter registration application to affirmatively state US citizenship before it is processed, sets a 30-day notice-and-sworn-statement step for applications with no citizenship answer, and orders the State Board to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens by a federal database. It also covers removal of deceased voters and precinct-official rules. It does not itself set an in-person ID rule in the text checked.

findings.motion: HB 958, Election Law Changes, House vote to concur in Senate committee substitute (passed 62-47)
findings.note: Voted no on concurrence. The bill page (https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookup/2025/H958) records a Governor veto on 8/17/2026.

subjects: photo ID for all voters (constitutional amendment, in person and by mail)

findings.note: Listed on the member's bill page and named as a cosponsor (G. Brown) on the bill page https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookUp/2025/H1246 for H1246, Safeguarding Elections Act. Its text (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H1246v0.pdf) makes it a Class 2 misdemeanor to demand citizenship documentation from a voter other than what State law requires during the voting process, and adds privacy protections for voter photo ID records.
